tools.name: chandelier_size
tools.description: What diameter and height of chandelier suits a room, and how far it should hang. Over a dining table, the diameter follows the table's width instead of the room. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: rug_size
tools.description: Which standard rug size fits a living room (from the room's size, leaving bare floor at the walls) or goes under a dining table (from the table's size, so chairs stay on the rug when pulled out). kind "living" takes the room in feet; kind "dining" takes the table in inches. Gives the designer rule o

tools.name: coffee_table_size
tools.description: How long and tall a coffee table should be for a sofa, and how wide for the room. Length is half to two thirds of the sofa; height is 1 to 2 inches below the seat. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: curtain_length
tools.description: Curtain panel length, the stock length to buy, rod width and total fabric width for a window. Style is how the curtain meets the floor: float, kiss, break or puddle. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: dining_table_size
tools.description: The largest rectangular and round dining table that fits a room with room to pull out chairs, and how many people each seats. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: christmas_tree_size
tools.description: The tallest Christmas tree that fits under a ceiling with a topper and stand, leaving a gap above, and how wide it will be. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: pendant_spacing
tools.description: How many pendant lights to hang over a kitchen island, how far apart, how far in from the ends, and how high above the counter. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: bathroom_mirror_size
tools.description: How wide a bathroom mirror should be for a vanity (70 to 90 percent of its width, one per sink for a double vanity) and how high its bottom edge goes. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: patio_umbrella_size
tools.description: What size patio umbrella covers a table and its chairs, from the table's shape and size, and how heavy a base it needs. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: bar_stool_height
tools.description: What seat height of stool suits a counter or bar (10 to 12 inches below its top), and how many stools fit along it. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: ceiling_fan_size
tools.description: What blade span of ceiling fan suits a room, from its floor area (two makers' charts), and which mount suits the ceiling height. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: wall_art_size
tools.description: How wide wall art over a sofa, bed or console should be (two-thirds to three-quarters of it), how high to hang it, and how tall it can be to center at 57 to 60 inches. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: sofa_size
tools.description: How long a sofa should be for a wall (about two-thirds of it; half to two-thirds is the range), what kind of sofa that is, the clearances around it, and the largest smallest-dimension that fits through a door. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: nightstand_size
tools.description: How tall a nightstand should be for a mattress (level with its top to 2 inches above; 3 inches either way still works), the typical width for the bed size, depth, the gap to leave, and the widest one that fits beside the bed on a given wall. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the a

tools.name: dresser_size
tools.description: The widest and deepest dresser that fits a bedroom wall: the wall space less an inch each side, and the distance to the bed less 36 inches of clearance to open the drawers. Says whether a wide, standard dresser or a chest suits it. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer show

tools.name: room_size
tools.description: A rectangular room's square feet, square meters, square yards and perimeter from its length and width in feet and inches, plus wall area and volume when the ceiling height is given. A foot is exactly 0.3048 meters. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: tv_stand_size
tools.description: How wide and tall a TV stand a TV needs: about 3 inches wider than the screen on each side, and the seated eye height less half the screen's height, so the middle of the screen sits at eye level. Also how far to sit: 1.5 to 2.5 times the screen size. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked

tools.name: outdoor_rug_size
tools.description: The standard outdoor rug size for a patio dining table (24 to 30 inches of rug past the table on every side) or a lounge set (every leg on the rug, 12 to 24 inches past it), and how much patio is left to walk around it (about 36 inches is the advice). Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linke

tools.name: headboard_size
tools.description: The headboard width for a bed size (2 to 4 inches wider than the mattress), the typical height above the mattress, the height from the floor, and whether the wall leaves room for nightstands beside it. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: bench_size
tools.description: The end-of-bed bench length for a bed size (4 to 8 inches of bed showing at each end), its height from the mattress top, the usual depth, and whether the space at the foot of the bed leaves a walkway. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: vanity_light_size
tools.description: How wide a bathroom vanity light over the mirror should be (80 to 90 percent of the mirror), how high to mount it, the ceiling clearance, and whether sconces beside the mirror work instead. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: wall_sconce_height
tools.description: How high to mount wall sconces in a hallway or room (center 60 to 65 inches up, 66 to 72 under ceilings over 9 feet) and how many to space along a wall, 8 to 10 feet apart. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: list_visualizers
tools.description: The kinds of products Renderior can show in a photo of the person's own space (furniture, sofas, lighting, patio furniture, vanities, front doors), each with its page. Use it to point someone to the right place to see a product at home before buying.
